_about: The cast of a playtest run (design/playtest-process.md, section 3). Behaviour comes from the fixed roster in design/scene-simulation-testing.md section 3 so results stay comparable run to run; experience and device are added because the first goal is UI coverage. Every character a seat makes is a TEST FIXTURE, never a proposal for one of the six real kids: invented by the agent, named with the PT- prefix, deleted afterwards, never written to data/characters/.

gm.name: The GM
gm.behaviour: Competent, prepared and honest about gaps. Runs the table from what the module gives a GM and nothing else.
mustExercise: the admin panel only as a last-resort workaround

caster.name: Caster
caster.behaviour: Diplomacy-first. Reads the room, tries the socially obvious approach, engages every topic offered. The persona a scene wants.
caster.chargenSeed: a terrestrial ancestry and a martial class: the plain path

brute.name: Brute
brute.behaviour: Impatient, physical, skips ahead. Tests whether a social scene has anything for a player who does not want to talk.
brute.chargenSeed: a non-terrestrial ancestry, so the induction terminal's lockdown fires

rules-lawyer.name: Rules-lawyer
rules-lawyer.behaviour: Asks for the DC before rolling, cross-references the sheet, presses on exactly-worded permissions.
rules-lawyer.chargenSeed: Witchwarper, the one class with a real key-ability choice
mustExercise: the check console's DC knob and difficulty bands

lateral-thinker.name: Lateral thinker
lateral-thinker.behaviour: Invents an approach nothing in the challenge file lists. The most important persona: every scene claims to price an invented approach on the same ladder, and this is the one that makes it prove it.
lateral-thinker.profileNote: Was the keyboard-only seat until 2026-10-06, when Ingram ruled keyboard-only play out of scope: Foundry requires a mouse and every player will have one.
lateral-thinker.chargenSeed: the rare background that grants a feat through a rule element (Escaped Experiment), or one whose skill grant is a prose choice (Starship Dweller)
mustExercise: an approach no challenge file lists

quiet-one.name: Quiet one
quiet-one.behaviour: Says little, watches, picks up what nobody addressed. Tests whether passive content has anywhere to land.
quiet-one.chargenSeed: every optional field left blank and no portrait

chaos-agent.name: Chaos agent
chaos-agent.behaviour: Deliberately off-script: refuses a beat outright, walks away, does the thing the brief did not expect, double-clicks, uses the browser's Back, closes windows mid-action.
chaos-agent.chargenSeed: a very long name with emoji, and a real portrait upload as a plain Player
